objective: Establish permanent work-entry, Clean Execution Baseline, upstream-first, status-topology, writer-boundary, and structured work-result standards using the smallest schema-backed repo-cp primitive.

granted: Inspect, modify, and test repo-cp within the requested standard and protocol scope
Use a private isolated repo-cp checkout to preserve overlapping pre-existing work
explicitly_not_granted: Commit, push, merge, publish, deploy, or mutate live systems
Modify peer repositories, Foundation artifacts, enrollment pins, or credentials

isolation.reason: The primary checkout contained pre-existing work and was behind the directly verified canonical baseline.

dependencies.description: The pinned Helix Agent Work Contract must match its required digest.
Implementation must use the current canonical repo-cp source without overwriting the dirty original checkout.
Fleet audit findings remain owned by enrolled peer repositories and repo-cp enrollment review.

expected_validation: Validate both JSON schemas and valid and invalid protocol fixtures
Run the full repo-cp and Foundation synthetic suite
Run the local file-integrity audit and enrolled fleet audit
Run Git whitespace and complete-diff checks

allowed: repo-cp work protocol documentation, schemas, bounded validator, CLI wiring, fixtures, tests, and task evidence
prohibited: Foundation vendor bytes, repository enrollment state, peer repositories, remote refs, credentials, and live systems

required_evidence: Dirty source and clean execution workspace evidence
Schema-valid task work entry and result
Git state, canonical parity, pre-existing dirtiness, comparison, and usage record
